categories.label: Heat Pumps
categories.title: Comfort for every season.
categories.description: Learn how modern heat pumps can provide efficient heating and cooling for Maine homes.
categories.contentEyebrow: A practical approach to home comfort
categories.contentDescription: The right system depends on your home's layout, insulation, existing heating system, comfort goals, and budget. A careful assessment helps identify options that make sense for your home.

contentItems.title: How heat pumps work
contentItems.description: Heat pumps move heat rather than create it by combustion. They can provide heating in colder weather and cooling during warmer months.

contentItems.title: Choosing a system
contentItems.description: System capacity, cold-weather performance, placement, and the home's layout all matter when choosing equipment.

categories.label: Ducted & Ductless
categories.title: The right distribution for your home.
categories.description: Compare ducted and ductless heat-pump approaches and learn what to consider before choosing.
categories.contentDescription: Ductless systems use indoor units placed in selected rooms or zones. Ducted systems distribute conditioned air through ductwork. The best approach depends on the home and the existing infrastructure.

contentItems.title: Ductless systems
contentItems.description: A flexible option for heating and cooling individual rooms or zones, often without adding conventional ductwork.

contentItems.title: Ducted systems
contentItems.description: A central air-distribution approach that may work well where suitable ductwork is already in place.

categories.label: Installations
categories.title: A careful installation makes a difference.
categories.description: Learn about the planning, equipment choices, and installation details behind a residential heat-pump project.
categories.contentEyebrow: From first conversation to finished system
categories.contentDescription: Every home is different. We discuss your comfort needs, review potential equipment locations and line-set routes, explain the proposed scope, and coordinate the work needed to complete the system.

contentItems.title: Home and system assessment
contentItems.description: We consider room layout, existing heating, insulation, electrical needs, equipment placement, and the goals you have for your home.

contentItems.title: Equipment and installation planning
contentItems.description: The proposed system and installation plan should reflect the home's needs, manufacturer requirements, and applicable program requirements.

categories.label: Maintenance
categories.title: Keep your system performing.
categories.description: Learn about heat-pump care, cleaning, and maintenance considerations for dependable operation.
categories.contentTitle: Keep your heat pump working well
categories.contentDescription: A little routine care helps support reliable operation. Follow the manufacturer's instructions for your specific equipment and arrange professional service when needed.

contentItems.title: Clean the filters
contentItems.description: Check indoor-unit filters regularly and clean them as directed by the manufacturer. Restricted airflow can affect comfort and performance.

contentItems.title: Keep outdoor equipment clear
contentItems.description: Keep leaves, snow, and other obstructions away from the outdoor unit. Do not chip or scrape ice from the equipment; follow the manufacturer's guidance.

contentItems.title: Schedule professional maintenance
contentItems.description: Have the system inspected when performance changes or service is due. Consult the owner's manual for recommended maintenance intervals.
